detail.contained_body: a kill term matched inside a longer role name. Check this before trusting the kill.
detail.gaps_none: Your evidence covers every stated requirement.
detail.not_checked_body: the description was truncated or silent on this. Treated as unknown, never as a failure.

entitlement.keyring_unavailable: Dawnlist could not open this computer's credential store (Credential Manager on Windows, Keychain on a Mac), where your licence key is kept, and this copy has not been verified recently. Unlock or restart the credential store and try again — nothing has been cancelled.
entitlement.licence_inactive: This licence key is real but no longer active — the subscription has lapsed, been cancelled or been refunded. Renew the subscription, then run again; if you believe it should still be active, write to Apps@spencerfields.com. Your board and your brief stay open either way.
entitlement.mac_lapsed: The App Store says your Dawnlist subscription is not active — it may have lapsed, been cancelled or been refunded. Renew it in the App Store, then press Restore purchase in Settings. Your board, your brief and everything already on this Mac stay open.
entitlement.mac_not_subscribed: No App Store subscription has been confirmed on this Mac yet, so there is no job feed to read. Subscribe in Settings, or press Restore purchase there if you have already subscribed. Your board, your brief and everything already on this Mac stay open.
entitlement.mac_unreachable: Could not reach the subscription service to confirm your App Store subscription, and it has not been confirmed recently. Check your connection and try again — nothing has been cancelled.
entitlement.no_variant: This copy of Dawnlist was packaged without a valid edition marker ({variant}), so it cannot tell which store it came from and will not run the morning search. Reinstall it from where you got it. Your board and your brief stay open either way.
families.armed_now: {name} is armed. Matching roles there will be screened out for nothing.
families.body: When you reject two roles of the same kind at one employer, Dawnlist offers a rule: kill that function at that employer, but keep reading the others. Nothing is armed until you say so, and every proposal shows the rejections it was built from.
families.heading: Employers you have turned down
families.none: Nothing proposed yet. These appear once you have rejected two similar roles at the same employer.
families.stood_down: {name} stood down. Nothing there is screened out by it now.
funnel.narrow_search: narrow this search: it matches more than one morning's page, so the postings past that page are never read
funnel.screen_drift: your screening rules removed {now}% of postings this run, against {before}% last run — check the rules if that was not intended
key.billing: Anthropic accepted the key, but the account behind it has no credit left. Add credit on the Billing page at console.anthropic.com, then check again.
key.forbidden: Anthropic recognised the key but refused it permission to use the models — usually a restriction on its organisation or workspace. Check the key's workspace at console.anthropic.com, or create a key in a workspace that allows it.
key.rate_limited: Anthropic is limiting requests on this key just now, so it could not be checked. The key itself may be fine — wait a minute and check again.
key.rejected: Anthropic rejected that key. Check that it was copied in full, or create a new one at console.anthropic.com.
key.unexpected: Anthropic did not complete the check ({name}). Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, create a new key at console.anthropic.com.
key.unreachable: Could not reach Anthropic to check the key. Check your connection and try again.
menu.language_changed: Dawnlist will be in {language} the next time you open it.
onboarding.aim_placeholder: A sentence or two, in your own words. What kind of role, roughly what level, where, permanent or contract, and the lowest salary worth a conversation. Anything you leave out, Dawnlist has to guess at.
onboarding.answer_placeholder: Your answer — leave blank if you would rather not say
onboarding.answers_added: {count} response(s) added to your background record above.
onboarding.answers_none: Nothing new to add — type an answer first.
onboarding.app_no_verdict: the assessment returned no verdict for this posting, so there is nothing yet to agree or disagree with
onboarding.blocker_decide: decide at least {needed} of the {total} postings ({decided} so far)
onboarding.blocker_sentence: {title} at {company}: you disagreed, so say what sentence, added to the brief, would have got this right — a correction without one will not persist
onboarding.blocker_short_sample: Dawnlist could not fetch enough live postings to calibrate against — {count} of the {needed} it needs. That is a setup problem rather than anything you have done: check a search is switched on and the feed is reachable, then try again.
onboarding.calibration_body: Here are ten live postings, with what Dawnlist made of each one. Correct anything it got wrong. Where you disagree, tell it what sentence would have got it right — that sentence goes into your brief, so the same mistake is not made again tomorrow.
onboarding.calibration_no_feed: Dawnlist has no job feed to read yet, because there is no subscription or access code on this computer. You can finish setting up; calibration will happen once you have one.
onboarding.calibration_skipped: There were not enough live postings to calibrate against, so this step has been skipped — nothing you did. Dawnlist will calibrate on a morning when a search is switched on and the feed is reachable. You can finish setting up.
onboarding.corpus_earliest_year: The earliest role found starts in {year}. If you worked before then, add it — early operational roles are what tell the screen which jobs you have actually done.
onboarding.corpus_none: No readable CV text was found — check the files opened correctly before continuing.
onboarding.corpus_one_version: Only one CV version was read. Different versions describe the same role in different words, and those differences are the evidence — add the older ones if you still have them.
onboarding.corpus_unreadable: Could not read enough text from: {files}
onboarding.disagreement: You disagree — Dawnlist said {app}, you say {user}.
onboarding.docx_unpacks_too_big: this .docx unpacks to far more data than any document needs, so it was not opened
onboarding.draft_failed: Could not draft from your CVs: {reason}. You can write both documents yourself and continue.
onboarding.drafted: Drafted. Correct anything that is wrong before continuing.
onboarding.drop_hint: Drop your CV files here — PDF, Word or plain text
onboarding.factsheet_label: Background factsheet — what may be said
onboarding.file_too_large: the file is {size} MB and the limit is {limit} MB — no CV is that large, so it was not opened
onboarding.ingest_guidance:
Drag in every version of your CV you still have — including the old ones, the ones tailored for a specific job, and the ones you think are out of date.

Do not tidy them up first. Different versions describe the same role in different words, and those differences are the evidence. A single polished CV is the least useful thing you can give this step.

If your CV starts part-way through your career, say so. Early roles are often cut from a senior CV, and the screen needs them: they are what tell it which operational jobs you have actually done, rather than only the ones you have managed.
onboarding.interview_body: Dawnlist has read your CVs and drafted two documents. Correct them — they are a starting point, not a verdict. The factsheet on the left is the only thing your outreach is allowed to claim about you. The brief on the right decides what gets surfaced each morning.
onboarding.low_signal: You agreed with everything, which usually means this sample was easy rather than that the brief is finished.
onboarding.open_questions: Dawnlist could not tell, and has left these open:
onboarding.pdf_too_many_pages: the PDF has {pages} pages and the limit is {limit} — that is not a CV, so it was not read
onboarding.ready: Ready — your brief will be updated with what you taught it.
onboarding.searches_body: These were suggested from what you said you are looking for. They start switched off, because each one costs money per posting it returns — so switch on the ones that are real searches, and leave the rest. You can change them at any time in Settings.
onboarding.searches_none: No searches were suggested. You can add them in Settings once you are set up.
onboarding.searches_nowhere: Dawnlist could not tell where you want the job to be based, so these cannot be switched on yet. A search with no location looks across the whole world, and every posting it returns is paid for. Go back and say where in your answer, or set it in Settings once you are set up.
onboarding.searches_off: Nothing is switched on, so tomorrow morning will be quiet. You can carry on and switch one on later in Settings.
onboarding.searches_where: Every search looks in {where}. You can change that in Settings.
onboarding.sentence_placeholder: What sentence, added to your brief, would have got this right?
onboarding.title: Dawnlist — setting up
rules.body: Before anything is read by a model, Dawnlist screens it against these terms. A posting killed here costs nothing; a posting that gets through costs a fraction of a penny to read. Start with none — add a term when you notice yourself making the same decision twice.
rules.conflict: Not added — this would have hidden a role you pursued:
rules.contextual_help: Words that mean something in a job title and nothing in a benefits paragraph. Matched against the title and company only.
rules.employers_help: Earned, not typed. Pursuing a role adds its employer here, and every later posting from them is read. Change the decision and it leaves again.
rules.heading: Screening rules
rules.strong_help: Signal anywhere — title, company or description. A posting matching one of these is always sent to be assessed.
rules.unsupported_help: Title terms that rule a posting out however good the employer. Checked first, and against every role you have pursued before it is accepted.
searches.body: These are the searches swept each morning. A search that is switched on costs money every day it runs, because the job feed bills per posting returned — so the ones Dawnlist suggested from what you told it start switched off until you have read them.
searches.heading: What Dawnlist looks for
searches.needs_where: {label} cannot be switched on until you set where you want to work. With no location it would look across the whole world.
searches.needs_where_first: Set where you want to work before adding a search. With no location it would look across the whole world.
searches.placeholder: a job title to look for
searches.switched_off: {label} is off. Nothing will be fetched for it.
searches.switched_on: {label} is on. It will be swept each morning.
searches.where_empty: Enter where you want to work, for example: London, GB
searches.where_needs_country: Add the two-letter country code, for example: London, GB
searches.where_placeholder: City and country code, for example: London, GB
settings.admin_body: Issue override codes, and withdraw them. A code grants access; it never sells anything. Say who each one is for — an unlabelled code cannot be accounted for later. A code meant for an app reviewer must allow several uses: a reviewer may test on more than one machine, or re-test after a rejection, and a spent code turns that into a failed review.
settings.admin_confirm_revoke: Withdraw {code}? It stops working at once, and so does every licence already redeemed from it. This cannot be undone.
settings.admin_expires_tip: How many days the code keeps working. Only an administrator's own code, or one on the owner plan, may be set to never expire.
settings.admin_issued: Issued {code}. Copy it now; it is shown once here.
settings.admin_no_licence: No licence on this machine, so there is nothing to administer.
settings.admin_revoked: {code} withdrawn. It stops working on the next attempt.
settings.admin_uses_tip: How many times this code may be redeemed. Never 1 for a reviewer.
settings.code_redeemed: Code accepted — your licence is saved.
settings.code_store_failed: The code was accepted, but Dawnlist could not save the licence it gave you because this computer's credential store did not respond. Your licence key is {key} — copy it now and keep it, because the code may not work a second time.
settings.data_body: Job postings in Dawnlist are licensed from a third-party data provider. You can use them for your own job search, including keeping the ones you shortlist. You may not redistribute or resell them, or use them to build a competing job service. These limits continue to apply to postings you keep after your subscription ends.
settings.data_heading: Where the job postings come from
settings.key_body: Dawnlist reads job postings and drafts your messages using Anthropic's models, on your own account. Create a key at console.anthropic.com and paste it here. You can revoke it at any time, and Dawnlist stores it in your operating system's credential manager — never in a file.
settings.key_forgotten: Key removed. Dawnlist cannot run until you add another.
settings.key_none: No key stored yet — Dawnlist cannot run without one.
settings.key_store_failed: Anthropic accepted the key, but Dawnlist could not save it because this computer's credential store (Credential Manager on Windows, Keychain on a Mac) did not respond. Nothing was saved. Check the credential store, then press Save and check again.
settings.licence_body: Paste the licence key from your purchase email. If you were given an override code instead, paste that — Dawnlist will exchange it for a licence.
settings.licence_inactive: This licence is no longer active — the subscription has lapsed, been cancelled or been refunded. Renew it and Dawnlist will run again.
settings.licence_store_failed: Dawnlist could not save the licence key because this computer's credential store (Credential Manager on Windows, Keychain on a Mac) did not respond. Nothing was saved — check the credential store, then press Save again.
settings.licence_unknown: The licence service does not recognise this key. Check it against your purchase email.
settings.licence_unverified: Saved, not yet verified — the licence service could not be reached. Dawnlist checks again before the next run.
settings.report_body: Dawnlist uses generative AI to judge postings and to draft your messages. If it produces something inappropriate, offensive or plainly wrong, report it and it will be read.
settings.subscribe_body: Dawnlist's job feed is a subscription, bought through the App Store. Everything already on this Mac stays open either way — your board, your brief and your tracker do not need a subscription to read.
settings.subscribe_deferred: Your purchase is waiting for approval — for example from the family organiser, under Ask to Buy. Dawnlist picks it up by itself once it is approved, so there is no need to buy again.
settings.subscribe_done: Subscribed. The feed reads for you from tomorrow morning.
settings.subscribe_still_waiting: The App Store has not answered yet. If no purchase sheet appeared, check that you are signed in to the App Store — for a test build, under System Settings, App Store, Sandbox Account. You can try again, restore an earlier purchase, or carry on and subscribe later.
settings.subscribe_terms: {title} — {length}. It renews automatically at the same price until you cancel it, which you can do at any time in System Settings.
settings.subscribe_unavailable: The App Store cannot take a purchase on this Mac right now.
settings.title: Dawnlist — settings
storekit.not_ready: The App Store connection is still starting. Try again in a moment.
storekit.not_saved: Your subscription is confirmed, but this Mac's Keychain would not save it. Dawnlist will try again the next time it opens — you will not be charged twice.
storekit.nothing_to_restore: Nothing to restore on this account.
storekit.unconfirmed: The App Store has the purchase, but Dawnlist could not confirm it with the subscription service yet. It will try again by itself the next time Dawnlist opens — you will not be charged twice.
update.body: This copy came from the website, so updates arrive from there too. The download page has the new version, signed, with its checksum published beside it. Nothing on this machine changes until you install it yourself.
update.title: Update available
voice.no_profile: No tone profile yet — add some of your own sent emails
